last.verdict: Palantir's growth is still accelerating: revenue nearly doubled, U.S. commercial passed U.S. government for the first time, and full-year guidance was raised again.

takeaways.label: Growth keeps accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 96% to $2.313B, the first quarter above $2B, with a 62% adjusted operating margin. Full-year revenue guidance rises to about $8.53B from about $8.15B.

takeaways.label: Commercial overtakes government
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue hit $984M, up 148% year over year and 29% from last quarter, passing U.S. government revenue ($953M) for the first time.

takeaways.label: Cash machine
takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $1.216B, a 53% margin. The company holds $10.4B in cash and Treasuries. Full-year free cash flow guidance is $4.8–5.0B.

takeaways.label: New deals lag revenue
takeaways.text: New contracts signed (total contract value) rose only 6% to $2.92B, and U.S. commercial remaining deal value grew just 4% from last quarter. Revenue growth is far outpacing new bookings.

history.verdict: Record growth and a huge forecast raise crushed expectations, sending shares soaring.

reasons.label: Biggest guidance raise ever
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook lifted to about $8.15B from $7.65B, well above Wall Street's view.

reasons.label: Revenue beat by wide margin
reasons.text: Revenue rose 93% to $1.94B versus roughly $1.81B expected; U.S. business grew 149%.

reasons.label: Record deals, high profits
reasons.text: U.S. commercial deal bookings hit $2.13B, up 153%, with a 62% adjusted operating margin.
